prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: private design reference for an existing Chinese desktop companion app called 在场. Generate one high fidelity desktop interface design, not a poster, not a product advertisement.
Primary request: A personal letter from the assistant appears naturally INSIDE the existing conversation. This is a quiet reading moment: warm grey, restrained muted gold, diffuse window light, transparent spatial atmosphere. The main content must be the actual Chinese letter with generous readable line height. It feels intimate and grounded, never a productivity report. The app has only familiar top navigation 聊天 / 今天 / 留下 and an unobtrusive bottom composer. No sidebar, no new dashboard.
Composition: straight-on desktop screenshot, landscape. A slender app header at top. A short preceding user message in the conversation. One editorial warm grey paper letter occupies the center of the conversation, softly defined edges rather than several nested cards, slight fine warm line on one side, subtle natural paper tint, mostly typography and whitespace. Assistant presence is a tiny understated avatar beside the letter margin, no large character illustration. A small date range is top right. The text is dark warm ink, gold only for very small source indices and one quiet action. Keep the letter source details collapsed: a small entry 那时的话 at the bottom. Continue/dismiss actions are genuine text links, not a giant call to action. Nearby ordinary chat text should be visible to show this really belongs to a conversation.
Exact Chinese content:
User message: 周末了，写封信陪我看看这一周吧。
Small letter eyebrow: 写给你
Small date: 10月12日—10月18日
Letter heading: 这一周，也有一些轻轻发亮的事
Letter paragraph 1: 我还记得周三晚上，你说想把那段时间留给自己。后来，我们没有再把它填满。¹
Letter paragraph 2: 周五聊到那个小项目时，你又开始讲起新的想法。我想先替你把这份好奇留在这里，不急着把它变成下一张清单。²
Letter paragraph 3: 这一周并不需要被收成一个漂亮的结论。那些还没有说清的，我们下次慢慢接着聊。
Small collapsed source entry: 那时的话
Actions: 接着聊聊 / 先收好
Composer placeholder: 你想说什么，都可以从这里开始
